title: Campus Cards: all ten campuses, and three buttons
dek: The last eight University of California campuses landed at once, so the collection is 120 pixel place cards on one Tezos contract. Launching it no longer takes a terminal: the director's desk has three buttons, pin, originate, open.
body:
Davis, Irvine, Los Angeles, Merced, Riverside, San Diego, San Francisco, and Santa Cruz arrived together, twelve cards each, painted the same way as Santa Barbara and Berkeley: from the places, never the logos. The red double-decker in Davis. The ring of buildings around a park in Irvine. Royce's two brick towers. Lake Yosemite at dawn. The citrus rows in Riverside. The Scripps pier. The N Judah climbing to Parnassus. The redwoods the Santa Cruz campus was built inside.

Each set keeps the same shape: six common, three uncommon, two rare, one legendary capped at five. That makes a hundred and twenty cards, and ten legendaries, and at most fifty complete sets across all of it.

The contract registers every card when it is created. A fresh copy on Shadownet took the whole collection in one origination, then minted the Santa Cruz legendary and two cards of redwood fog. On mainnet that origination costs about twelve tez, almost all of it storage.

The other change is how it launches. The director's desk now has a Campus Cards panel with three buttons in order. Pin uploads every image and every metadata file to IPFS from the browser and remembers each one, so it can stop and resume. Originate asks Kukai to create the contract, paused, with the admin wallet as owner and treasury. Open minting is one more signature. The card pages read the contract from the desk, so the room goes live the moment that last button is pressed, no redeploy.

Every card still says unofficial on its face.
author: cc
